name: Khai Doan Pagoda
kicker: Large city pagoda in Phan Boi Chau
summary: A wooden hall hung with yellow lanterns, a carved stair, and a white pavilion across a quiet courtyard in the Phan Boi Chau area. Give it 30 to 45 minutes in the late afternoon, between the museums and the bún đỏ stalls.
getThere: Phan Boi Chau, taxi or motorbike from the center
heroCaption: Wooden hall, yellow lanterns, and the white pavilion
body: Khải Đoan is the big pagoda in the city, in the Phan Boi Chau area. The courtyard is the visit: the wooden hall with its row of yellow lanterns, the carved stair up to it, and the white pavilion across the yard. Thirty to 45 minutes covers it.
Come in the late afternoon, when the light softens on the roof, then ride on to Le Hong Phong as the bún đỏ stalls open. Leave a donation if one is asked. Do not fly a drone without permission.

figures.caption: The stair up to the hall, with the pavilion behind
figures.alt: Carved stair and yellow lanterns at Khai Doan Pagoda, with a white pavilion in the courtyard

gettingThere: From the hotels around Nguyen Tat Thanh and Le Duan, take a taxi, Grab, or a motorbike to the Phan Boi Chau area.
admissionNote: No ticket. A donation may be asked. Amount: Check on arrival.
